items.title: Enrolment enquiries scattered across WhatsApp
items.before: Enquiry, trial class, enrolment, and payment lived in different chats and sheets; leave days broke continuity.
items.sprint: Locked onto enquiry → trial → enrolment; clarified owners, follow-up nodes, and a simple status board.
items.after: Every enquiry has an owner and next step; the owner stops chasing daily updates.
items.metric: Fewer missed follow-ups; enrolment conversion visible on one page.

items.title: Slow quotes, many versions, verbal handoffs
items.before: Quotes waited on missing data; each colleague had a different “latest” version; reminders exposed missed follow-ups.
items.sprint: Clarified quote inputs, ownership, and approval nodes; one trackable checklist.
items.after: Quotes follow a standard rhythm; handoffs are no longer verbal-only.
items.metric: Shorter average quote time; fewer repeat data requests.

items.title: Schedule / payments / attendance on WhatsApp + Excel
items.before: Coaches tracked classes, unpaid students, and commissions differently; admins firefought daily.
items.sprint: Applied the same “fix workflow, then tools” method: ownership, status, reminders, export reconciliation.
items.after: Schedule, student status, and payment reminders live in one place — memory no longer runs the studio.
items.metric: Unpaid follow-up has reminders; attendance / commission export is possible.

about.title: I am the consultant who may tell you not to buy yet.
about.intro: After more than a decade in IT delivery, the failure I saw most was not bad builds — it was perfect delivery that nobody used.
body: The same people kept using WhatsApp and Excel, and nobody said so out loud.
Looking back, the problem was rarely the tool — the workflow itself had never been clarified. The SOP lived only in the owner’s head, so one leave day broke everything.
So I changed the approach: fix one workflow first until it works and the team actually uses it — then talk about AI or systems.

items.question: What does InnovateXP do?
items.answer: InnovateXP Limited is a Hong Kong AI business consultancy founded by Larry Lo. We help SMEs fix one revenue or operations workflow first—ownership, SOP, and follow-up—then adopt AI, CRM, or automation only when it is justified. Entry offer: 30-day Discovery Sprint from HK$6,800.

items.question: Who is Larry Lo?
items.answer: Larry Lo is the founder of InnovateXP Limited and an AI Business Consultant in Hong Kong, with 13+ years of IT delivery experience and seven dated 2025 public host/speaker/showcase records at GDG Hong Kong, PISM Sharing, and DevFest Hong Kong.

items.question: Are we ready for AI now?
items.answer: Not every team should start with AI immediately. Start with one workflow and decide based on real operational value.

items.question: Do we need a CRM first?
items.answer: Not always. Ownership, handoff clarity, and follow-up rhythm usually come before buying a new system.

items.question: How quickly can we see improvement?
items.answer: Usually by focusing on one workflow first. We do not start with a company-wide overhaul.

items.question: What if the team resists a new system?
items.answer: Adoption matters as much as the tool. The workflow and handoff design must fit how the team actually works.

items.question: What happens in the 30-minute diagnosis?
items.answer: We focus on one workflow, identify leakage and ownership gaps, and decide what is worth fixing first.

items.question: We are a very small company. Is it still worth doing?
items.answer: Yes, especially when one absence can stall the whole workflow. The main path starts at HK$6,800 for a 30-day Sprint with up to 10 people.
